pages.title: Cleaver for Congress | Join the Movement for Progress
pages.text:
## Hear from President Bill Clinton
Click play to listen to former President Bill Clinton’s radio ad supporting Congressman Cleaver’s re-election.
President Bill Clinton for Emanuel Cleaver
Cleaver for Congress Radio Ad
“ Emanuel Cleaver has been a steady friend of the environment. He’s scored 100 percent on the most recent evaluation from our friends at the League of Conservation Voters. He’s a co-chair of the House Renewable Energy Caucus, helping guide our nation towards a clean energy future. And he’s worked hard to build the Green Impact Zone in KC’s urban heart, bringing cost-savings to his constituents and cleaner air to us all. He’s just what we need in Congress. ”
— Bill McKibben, founder, Third Act
Cleaver Raises Concerns as Missouri’s Congressional Map Remains in Legal Limbo
With the November election approaching, Congressman Emanuel Cleaver is raising concerns about uncertainty surrounding Missouri’s Fifth Congressional District as legal challenges to the state’s mid-decade redistricting continue. The Hill reports on the competing court cases, questions over which congressional map will ultimately govern the election, and Cleaver’s argument that the unusual redistricting process has created unnecessary confusion for voters and candidates.
## Congressman Cleaver on NPR
Congressman Cleaver discusses Missouri’s congressional map, housing challenges and the importance of protecting fair representation.
Cleaver begins speaking at the 14:00 mark.
Cleaver Joins Bipartisan Effort to Restore Health Insurance Tax Credits After Premium Hikes
U.S. Representatives Emanuel Cleaver and Sharice Davids supported legislation in the House to restore Affordable Care Act premium tax credits that had lapsed, after thousands of Kansas City families faced sharp health insurance cost increases. Cleaver highlighted that extending these credits would provide immediate financial relief to tens of thousands of constituents struggling with soaring premiums.
Cleaver Reaffirms Plans to Run Again Amid Missouri Redistricting Efforts
Amid ongoing debate over redistricting in Missouri and national pressure from presidential figures, Congressman Cleaver reaffirmed his intention to run for re-election in 2026. He stressed his commitment to representing Kansas City despite efforts to redraw district lines in a way that could disadvantage his seat.
Cleaver on Temporary Shutdown as Funding Deal Delays DHS Votes
As a partial federal government shutdown took effect over the weekend due to stalled legislation, Congressman Cleaver weighed in on the situation, emphasizing ongoing negotiations over Department of Homeland Security funding and immigration enforcement priorities. He highlighted concerns about training and accountability within DHS agencies while urging Congress to act swiftly to reopen the full government.
Cleaver Delivers $850,000 to Transform Grandview into Community Hub
Congressman Cleaver secured $850,000 in federal funding for the future home of the Grandview Farmers Market, helping bring new life to a long-vacant site in the city’s downtown. The project, now named Grandview Station , will serve as a year-round gathering space featuring local vendors, small businesses, and community events — boosting economic development and access to fresh food for residents.
Cleaver Highlights Redistricting Fight in Missouri
In national broadcast coverage, Congressman Cleaver discusses the unprecedented efforts by Missouri lawmakers to redraw congressional maps — a move he says threatens fair representation and could undermine voter influence in Kansas City.
Cleaver Calls on Olin Winchester to Negotiate in Good Faith with Union Workers
Congressman Cleaver joined Rep. Wesley Bell in urging Olin Winchester leadership to return to the bargaining table and negotiate a fair contract with more than 1,300 striking workers at the Lake City Army Ammunition Plant. In a letter to company leadership, they emphasized that collective bargaining is a cornerstone of U.S. labor law and warned that prolonged delays could harm both working families and the nation’s defense supply chain.
Cleaver Delivers Major Federal Investments Across Kansas City Region
Congressman Cleaver secured more than $13 million in federal funding for critical projects across Missouri’s Fifth District, supporting public safety, transportation, housing improvements and community development. Major investments include upgrades for the Kansas City Police Department, improvements to public housing and funding for transportation and neighborhood revitalization projects throughout the district.
Cleaver Demands Release of Federal Funds to Prevent Layoffs
Congressman Cleaver and Rep. Sharice Davids are calling on the Trump Administration to immediately release congressionally approved funding for National Heritage Areas, warning that months-long delays are putting museum staff, historic sites and educational programs at risk. The lawmakers said withholding funds already signed into law could force layoffs and disrupt preservation efforts across the 41-county Freedom's Frontier National Heritage Area spanning Missouri and Kansas.
Kansas City Star Highlights Cleaver's Leadership Legacy
The Kansas City Star profiled Congressman Emanuel Cleaver's decades of public service, from serving as Kansas City's first Black mayor to becoming a leading voice in Congress on housing, economic development and bipartisan leadership. The feature examines Cleaver's lasting impact on the region as he seeks another term representing Missouri's Fifth District.
Bipartisan Amendment Advances Critical Tick-Borne Disease Research
Congressman Emanuel Cleaver successfully secured $5 million in federal funding for alpha-gal syndrome research through the Fiscal Year 2027 National Defense Authorization Act after his bipartisan amendment was adopted. The funding will support research into the increasingly common tick-borne illness, improve patient care, and advance the search for effective treatments, addressing a growing public health concern affecting thousands of Missourians and hundreds of thousands of Americans.
Cleaver Investigates Alleged Abuse and Extreme Work Hours in Veterinary Education
Congressman Cleaver launched a congressional inquiry into allegations of widespread mistreatment and extreme work hours at U.S. veterinary schools. In letters sent to 36 institutions nationwide, he requested information on student workload expectations, protections against exploitation, and safeguards for student well-being. Cleaver emphasized that academic rigor must never come at the expense of student health, mental well-being, or quality patient care.
Cleaver Faces GOP Challenger Lineup as Filing Deadline Passes
Four Republican candidates have officially filed to challenge Congressman Emanuel Cleaver in Missouri’s new 5th District following the legislature’s controversial redistricting plan. The filing list includes…
Cleaver Confirms 2026 Run as Redistricting Leaves District Boundaries Unclear
Congressman Cleaver has filed for reelection in 2026, but ongoing legal battles over Missouri’s controversial redistricting map leave uncertainty around exactly which district he will represent. The proposed map would significantly reshape his Kansas City–based district, potentially extending it deep into more rural areas and creating new electoral challenges. Despite the uncertainty, Cleaver remains focused on serving his current constituents while the courts and state officials determine which map will be in effect.
Cleaver’s Record of Public Service Remains Central Amid Redistricting Fight
In a Kansas City Star opinion column, Mará Rose Williams reflects on Congressman Cleaver’s nearly 50 years of public service, from his time as Kansas City’s first Black mayor to his longtime leadership in Congress. As Missouri’s new redistricting map threatens to reshape his path to reelection, the piece highlights Cleaver’s legacy of unifying communities, championing Kansas City’s East Side and delivering lasting civic projects like the 18th & Vine Jazz District.
Opinion Column Highlights Concerns Over Missouri’s Political Future
In an opinion piece by columnist Mary Sanchez, Congressman Cleaver’s fight against Missouri’s controversial redistricting efforts is highlighted as part of a broader concern over threats to democratic representation in the state. The column examines growing fears about gerrymandering, voter disenfranchisement and the long-term impact on fair elections in Missouri.
Watch Cleaver Discuss Bipartisanship and Restoring Trust in Congress
In a FOX4 4 The People segment, Congressman Cleaver discusses Congress’s low approval ratings, the importance of bipartisan cooperation and why delivering results for constituents must come before partisan politics.
Cleaver Calls for Housing Reform to Remain Above Partisan Politics
After President Trump postponed signing the bipartisan 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act , Congressman Cleaver expressed disappointment that a broadly supported housing bill had become entangled in unrelated political negotiations. A lead architect of the legislation, Cleaver emphasized that the bill was crafted through bipartisan cooperation to expand housing supply, improve affordability and help more Americans achieve homeownership.
AFGE Backs Cleaver for Reelection
The American Federation of Government Employees (AFGE), the nation's largest union representing federal and D.C. government employees, endorsed Congressman Emanuel Cleaver for reelection, citing his 100% voting record on the union's top legislative priorities . The endorsement recognized Cleaver's longstanding support for protecting federal workers, strengthening public services and advocating for working families.
Watch: Cleaver Explains Historic Bipartisan Housing Bill
Congressman Emanuel Cleaver joined KCTV5 to discuss the newly enacted 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act , the most significant bipartisan housing reform package in nearly 50 years. In the interview, he explains how the legislation will expand housing opportunities, modernize federal programs and help address the nation's housing affordability crisis through bipartisan cooperation.
Cleaver: Trump Administration’s Response to ICE Shooting “Completely Irresponsible”
On Up to Date , Congressman Cleaver criticized the Trump administration’s response to a controversial ICE-related shooting, calling the characterization of the incident “completely irresponsible.” He emphasized the importance of waiting for a full investigation and underscored that premature labels can inflame tensions without clear evidence.
Legal Battle Over Missouri’s Congressional Map Continues Ahead of Election
The legal fight over Missouri’s congressional boundaries is moving to the 8th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals , adding another chapter to the dispute over which map should govern the upcoming election. The controversy directly affects the Fifth Congressional District represented by Congressman Emanuel Cleaver, while Missouri voters will also weigh Proposition A , which would reject the 2025 map and restore the state’s 2022 congressional lines. St. Louis Public Radio
Cleaver Stands Up for Missouri Farmers and the Kansas City Economy
As escalating tariffs between the United States and Canada threaten to make Kansas City one of the hardest-hit metro areas in the country, Congressman Emanuel Cleaver is raising concerns about the impact on local businesses, farmers and consumers. Cleaver criticized policies that could further weaken cattle markets, arguing that increased foreign beef imports would discourage American ranchers from expanding their herds while doing little to lower costs for families. Kansas City exports roughly $4 billion to Canada, representing about 37% of the metro’s total exports , making the region particularly vulnerable to a prolonged trade dispute.
Cleaver Fights to Protect Kansas City’s Voice Ahead of Major Court Battle
Ahead of a high-stakes court fight over Missouri’s new congressional map, Congressman Emanuel Cleaver spoke with The Kansas City Star about the impact of the mid-decade redistricting effort on Kansas City and the Fifth District. Cleaver called the unprecedented redraw “cheating” and emphasized the importance of protecting fair representation as his district stretches from Kansas City into rural mid-Missouri.
Housing Summit Focuses on Putting Landmark Affordable Housing Law Into Action
Congressman Cleaver helped bring housing leaders together in Kansas City to discuss implementation of the new federal housing law and its potential impact on Missouri communities. Cleaver highlighted provisions designed to spur affordable housing construction, expand financing opportunities in rural communities and limit large institutional investors from accumulating single-family homes.
Cleaver Highlights Community Service on Martin Luther King Jr. Day
In Kansas City’s MLK Day volunteer efforts, community members — including those connected to Congressman Cleaver’s district — packed care kits with essentials like peanut butter and jelly sandwiches, bed mats made from recycled plastic bags, and handwritten notes of encouragement for those in need. The event showcased how Kansas Citians continue the legacy of service and compassion that Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. championed.
Cleaver Voices Concern Over Proposed DHS Detention Facility in KC
In a recent interview, Congressman Cleaver told local media that the Department of Homeland Security’s plan to expand large detention facilities — including one in Kansas City — raises serious questions about community impact and transparency, and that the administration must answer constituents’ concerns before moving forward.
Cleaver Among Top Missouri Federal and State Candidates in Morning Digest
The Downballot’s Morning Digest spotlighted key Missouri political races and notable incumbents — including Congressman Emanuel Cleaver — as candidates begin organizing for the 2026 election cycle. Coverage included updates on campaign filings, fundraising, and issues shaping the contests ahead.
Cleaver Allies Move Closer to Putting Gerrymandered Map on Ballot
Opponents of Missouri’s controversial congressional redistricting plan announced they have gathered enough signatures to potentially force a statewide vote on the map. Organizers say they exceeded the required threshold across multiple districts, marking a major step toward letting voters decide whether to overturn the GOP-backed map that reshapes Kansas City’s representation.
Cleaver Addresses Congress’s Low Approval Ratings and Need for Cooperation
On FOX4’s 4 The People , Congressman Cleaver joined a bipartisan discussion on Congress’s historically low approval ratings, emphasizing the need for greater cooperation and problem-solving in Washington. Alongside Rep. Derek Schmidt, Cleaver highlighted how restoring trust requires leaders to focus on delivering results for constituents rather than partisan gridlock.
Cleaver Prepares for Reelection Under Missouri’s New Redistricting Map
Missouri’s newly approved congressional map is officially set for the 2026 election cycle, reshaping Kansas City’s representation and dramatically altering the boundaries of Congressman Cleaver’s district. Despite ongoing political and legal battles surrounding the controversial map, Cleaver remains focused on his reelection campaign and continuing to advocate for Kansas City communities amid the changing political landscape.
Cleaver Helps Advance Major Housing Reform with Overwhelming Bipartisan Support
The House passed the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act in a sweeping 395-13 bipartisan vote , marking one of the most significant housing reform efforts in decades. Congressman Cleaver, a leading voice on housing policy in Congress, helped advance the legislation aimed at expanding housing supply, modernizing federal housing programs and improving affordability for working families nationwide.
Cleaver’s Housing Agenda Featured as Landmark Bill Advances
Punchbowl News highlighted the growing momentum behind the bipartisan 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act , one of the most significant housing reform efforts in decades. As a leading voice on housing policy and Ranking Member of the House Housing and Insurance Subcommittee, Congressman Cleaver has played a key role in advancing reforms aimed at increasing housing supply, modernizing federal programs and expanding affordable housing opportunities for working families. The legislation has earned broad bipartisan support as Congress continues to address the nation’s housing affordability crisis.
Cleaver Pushes Back on Renewed Election Fraud Claims
Bipartisan Bill Would Expand EHR Support for Home Health Providers
Congressman Emanuel Cleaver joined a bipartisan group of lawmakers in introducing legislation to extend federal electronic health record (EHR) grant funding to home health agencies and other post-acute care providers that were excluded from earlier incentive programs. The proposal would help providers adopt modern health information technology, improve care coordination, reduce administrative burdens and deliver better outcomes for patients receiving care at home.
Cleaver Demands Congressional Investigation After Death of Renee Goods
Congressman Cleaver called for a congressional investigation into the death of Renee Goods, urging accountability and transparency after the tragic incident gained public attention. His statement reflects deep concern for justice and proper federal oversight regarding the circumstances surrounding her death.
Fight Over Fifth District Map Heads Back to Court Ahead of November Election
A new lawsuit is seeking to restore Missouri’s Fifth Congressional District to its 2022 boundaries before the November election, challenging the controversial 2025 redistricting effort that dramatically reshaped Congressman Cleaver’s district. As Cleaver prepares to face state Sen. Rick Brattin, the legal battle could determine whether Kansas City voters cast their ballots under the old or newly drawn congressional map. The report also highlights rural constituents who spoke positively about Cleaver’s previous representation of their communities.
Cleaver Opposes Trump Plan to Ban Investors from Single-Family Home Market
Congressman Cleaver joined House Democrats in pushing back against a Trump administration proposal that would restrict investors from buying single-family homes. Critics, including Cleaver, argue that the plan could reduce overall housing supply and drive up costs for everyday homebuyers — especially first-time buyers and working families already struggling in today’s market.
Cleaver Backs SBE Council Support for Bipartisan Housing Act
The State and Local Government Council (SBE Council) released a statement backing the Housing for the 21st Century Act — legislation Cleaver helped advance in the House Financial Services Committee. The council emphasized how the act’s bipartisan reforms could modernize federal housing programs, increase supply, and address affordability challenges.
Cleaver Explains Why He Did Not Boycott Trump’s State of the Union
On Up to Date , Congressman Cleaver discussed his decision not to boycott President Trump’s 2026 State of the Union address. He explained that, while he has serious policy disagreements with the administration, attending key national forums allows him to advocate for Missouri’s interests and hold leaders accountable from a seat at the table.

pages.text:
## Working for Missouri Families.
From protecting Social Security and Medicare to supporting small businesses and expanding affordable housing, explore Congressman Cleaver's priorities for Missouri's Fifth District.
View Palm Card
## Housing
Growing up in public housing inspired Congressman Cleaver to make accessible, affordable housing for all a life-long crusade. His bipartisan efforts in Congress enabled the passage of the largest housing reform law in modern history.
## Social Security, Medicare and Medicaid
The long-term solvency of Social Security and Medicare are commitments that Congressman Cleaver believes are unwavering for our country. He has and will continue to fight for the investments needed to maintain these programs for our seniors.
He supports expanding Medicaid and closing gaps in coverage to ensure that underserved and rural communities have access to local health care needed without having to travel hours to receive care.
## Health Care
A priority for Congressman Cleaver is ensuring that Missourians have access to affordable, quality health coverage. He has been an ardent supporter and defender of the Affordable Care Act (ACA), which has helped bring coverage to millions of Americans. He believes the ACA should be strengthened.
Congressman Cleaver has fought to lower the cost of prescription drugs so families do not have to choose between their medications and their groceries.
Congressman Cleaver disagrees with the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn Roe v. Wade and believes that decision undermines women’s right to make their own health care decisions. He believes that reproductive health care decisions need to be between women and their doctors.
## Gun and Public Safety
Congressman Cleaver supports bipartisan, common-sense gun safety legislation, keeping our children and neighborhoods safe while respecting the responsible ownership of guns. He is committed to making sure law enforcement has the funds, resources, and training necessary to reduce crime and violence to save lives so our families feel safe in our community.
## Education
Congressman Cleaver believes education and training are critical for our region, state and country. He is committed to affordable and accessible education and workforce training opportunities for all. He wants to ensure students have the skills and education needed for thevjobs of today and of the future.
## Jobs and Economy
Remaining focused on job creation, supporting small businesses, and making investments in our future economy are core values of Congressman Cleaver’s work in Congress. He knows that small businesses are the engine creating jobs that build our economy.
## Veterans
Congressman Cleaver is proud to salute and represent thousands of military service members, veterans, and their families. He supports improving health care for veterans and ensuring that they receive the benefits they have earned protecting our country.
## Transportation
Improving and addressing the 5th District’s transportation needs continues being a priority for Congressman Cleaver. His efforts have secured billions of dollars investment for our community and State, including the repair and new construction of highways, roads, bridges, transit, and water projects.
## Civility
Working across the aisle with Republican colleagues is and continues to be a hallmark of Congressman Cleaver’s actions in Congress. He knows that with consensus developed through compromise and collaboration our nation’s policies are better.
